import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

binary, mode = sys.argv[1:]
events = []
canonical = {}

def call(state, operation, *args, expected=0):
    command = [binary, 'node', operation, *map(str, args)]
    if state is not None:
        command += ['--state-root', str(state)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    events.append({'operation': operation, 'exit': result.returncode})
    if result.returncode != expected:
        raise AssertionError((command, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr))
    return result

def protected(state):
    paths = ['startup-receipt.preserves', 'shutdown-receipt.preserves',
             'stop-control-receipt.preserves', 'control/node.lock.preserves',
             'control/current-run.preserves']
    paths += sorted(str(p.relative_to(state)) for p in (state/'receipts').glob('adapter-shutdown-*.preserves'))
    return {name: (state/name).read_bytes() if (state/name).is_file() else None for name in paths}

def prefix(base):
    state = base/'state'
    request = base/'shutdown-r.preserves'
    first_loop = base/'first-loop.preserves'
    call(state, 'init', '--node-id', 'node:f14-cli')
    call(state, 'run')
    first_binding = (state/'control/current-run.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(None, 'control-request', '--operation', 'shutdown', '--out', request,
         '--authority', 'blake3:'+'a'*64, '--policy', 'blake3:'+'b'*64,
         '--resource', 'blake3:'+'c'*64)
    call(state, 'control-submit', request)
    result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', '--receipt-out', first_loop)
    assert 'stopped=yes' in result.stdout
    assert not (state/'control/node.lock.preserves').exists()
    original_control = (state/'stop-control-receipt.preserves').read_bytes()
    original_shutdown = (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(state, 'run')
    second_binding = (state/'control/current-run.preserves').read_bytes()
    assert first_binding != second_binding
    assert not (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').exists()
    assert not (state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').exists()
    return state, request, first_loop, original_control, original_shutdown

def positive(base):
    state, request, first_loop, old_control, old_shutdown = prefix(base)
    before = protected(state)
    call(state, 'control-submit', request)
    duplicate_loop = base/'duplicate-loop.preserves'
    result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', '--receipt-out', duplicate_loop)
    assert 'stopped=no' in result.stdout
    assert protected(state) == before
    assert not (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').exists()
    first_text, duplicate_text = first_loop.read_text(), duplicate_loop.read_text()
    dispatch = r'<dispatch-receipts \[([^]]+)\]>'
    assert re.search(dispatch, first_text).group(1) == re.search(dispatch, duplicate_text).group(1)
    result = call(state, 'status')
    assert 'node status running ' in result.stdout, result.stdout
    legacy_control, legacy_shutdown = base/'legacy-control.preserves', base/'legacy-shutdown.preserves'
    legacy_control.write_bytes(old_control)
    legacy_shutdown.write_bytes(old_shutdown)
    call(None, 'show', legacy_control)
    call(None, 'show', legacy_shutdown)
    fresh = base/'shutdown-new-request.preserves'
    call(None, 'control-request', '--operation', 'shutdown', '--out', fresh,
         '--authority', 'blake3:'+'a'*64, '--policy', 'blake3:'+'b'*64,
         '--resource', 'blake3:'+'c'*64, '--evidence', 'blake3:'+'d'*64)
    assert fresh.read_bytes() != request.read_bytes()
    call(state, 'control-submit', fresh)
    current_loop = base/'current-loop.preserves'
    result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', '--receipt-out', current_loop)
    assert 'stopped=yes' in result.stdout
    assert not (state/'control/node.lock.preserves').exists()
    completion = state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves'
    assert completion.is_file()
    call(state, 'status')
    canonical.update({'first_loop': first_text, 'duplicate_loop': duplicate_text,
                      'current_loop': current_loop.read_text(),
                      'current_run': (state/'control/current-run.preserves').read_text(),
                      'completion': completion.read_text()})
    return ['current-shutdown-stops', 'historical-duplicate-keeps-active-lock',
            'duplicate-retains-original-dispatch-ref', 'new-request-stops-current-run',
            'legacy-control-and-shutdown-stay-readable']

def negative(base):
    cases = []
    for damage in ['missing-run', 'malformed-run', 'unreadable-completion', 'conflicting-lock-run', 'historical-shutdown-artifact']:
        case = base/damage
        case.mkdir()
        state, request, _, _, old_shutdown = prefix(case)
        call(state, 'control-submit', request)
        if damage == 'missing-run':
            (state/'control/current-run.preserves').unlink()
        elif damage == 'malformed-run':
            (state/'control/current-run.preserves').write_text('<invalid-run>')
        elif damage == 'unreadable-completion':
            (state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').mkdir()
        elif damage == 'conflicting-lock-run':
            lock = state/'control/node.lock.preserves'
            value, count = re.subn(r'<run "blake3:[0-9a-f]{64}">', '<run "blake3:'+'e'*64+'">', lock.read_text())
            assert count == 1
            lock.write_text(value)
        else:
            (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').write_bytes(old_shutdown)
        before = protected(state)
        result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', expected=0 if damage == 'historical-shutdown-artifact' else 1)
        if damage == 'historical-shutdown-artifact':
            assert '<decision "deny">' in result.stdout
            assert '<stopped "no">' in result.stdout
        assert 'stopped=yes' not in result.stdout
        assert protected(state) == before
        assert (state/'control/node.lock.preserves').is_file()
        cases.append(damage+'-rejected-without-lifecycle-change')
    state, _, _, _, _ = prefix(base/'legacy')
    call(state, 'stop')
    (state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').unlink()
    before = protected(state)
    call(state, 'status', expected=1)
    call(state, 'run', expected=1)
    assert protected(state) == before
    cases.append('legacy-completion-cannot-prove-current-stopped-or-reset-lineage')
    return cases

try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='molten-f14-cli-consumer-') as temporary:
        base = Path(temporary)
        (base/'legacy').mkdir()
        cases = positive(base) if mode == 'positive' else negative(base)
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'canonical': canonical}, sort_keys=True))
    if mode == 'negative':
        print('Expected current-run observation denials executed; lifecycle state remained unchanged.', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0 if mode == 'positive' else 1)
except Exception as error:
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
    print(json.dumps({'events': events}), file=sys.stderr)
    print(repr(error), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

binary, mode = sys.argv[1:]
events, canonical = [], {}

def call(root, operation, *args, expected=0):
    argv = [binary, 'node', operation, *map(str, args)]
    if root is not None:
        argv += ['--state-root', str(root)]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    events.append({'argv': argv, 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    if expected is not None:
        assert result.returncode == expected, events[-1]
    return result

def start(base):
    root = base/'state'
    call(root, 'init', '--node-id', 'node:f14-review-consumer')
    call(root, 'run')
    return root

def request(base, extra=False):
    path = base/('shutdown-extra.preserves' if extra else 'shutdown.preserves')
    args = ['--operation', 'shutdown', '--out', path,
            '--authority', 'blake3:'+'a'*64, '--policy', 'blake3:'+'b'*64,
            '--resource', 'blake3:'+'c'*64]
    if extra:
        args += ['--evidence', 'blake3:'+'d'*64]
    call(None, 'control-request', *args)
    return path

def protected(root):
    names = ['startup-receipt.preserves', 'shutdown-receipt.preserves',
             'stop-control-receipt.preserves', 'control/node.lock.preserves',
             'control/current-run.preserves', 'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves']
    names += sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in (root/'receipts').glob('adapter-shutdown-*.preserves'))
    return {name: ((root/name).read_bytes().hex() if (root/name).is_file()
                   else 'directory' if (root/name).is_dir() else None) for name in names}

def completed_with_pending(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    requests = [request(base), request(base, True)]
    request_values = {path.read_bytes() for path in requests}
    for path in requests:
        call(root, 'control-submit', path)
    receipt = base/'serve.preserves'
    result = call(root, 'serve', '--max-ticks', '1', '--max-requests-per-tick', '1',
                  '--receipt-out', receipt, expected=None)
    assert result.returncode in [0, 1], events[-1]
    value = receipt.read_text()
    canonical['completed-with-pending'] = value
    assert '<decision "deny">' in value, value
    assert not (root/'control/node.lock.preserves').exists()
    assert (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').is_file()
    assert '<stopped "true">' in value, value
    assert sum(member.read_bytes() in request_values for member in (root/'control/inbox').iterdir() if member.is_file()) == 1
    return 'completed-shutdown-remains-stopped-despite-pending-work-denial'

def repeat_stop(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    call(root, 'stop')
    completed = (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(root, 'stop', expected=1)
    result = call(root, 'status')
    assert 'node status stopped ' in result.stdout, result.stdout
    assert (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').read_bytes() == completed
    canonical['repeat-stop-completion'] = completed.decode()
    call(root, 'run')
    assert 'node status running ' in call(root, 'status').stdout
    return 'denied-repeat-stop-does-not-invalidate-immutable-current-completion'

def unavailable_status(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').mkdir()
    before = protected(root)
    call(root, 'status', expected=1)
    assert protected(root) == before
    return 'unreadable-completion-rejects-active-status-without-lifecycle-mutation'

def unresolved_service(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    shutdown = request(base)
    call(root, 'control-submit', shutdown)
    call(root, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1')
    old_completion = (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(root, 'run')
    (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').write_bytes(old_completion)
    call(root, 'control-submit', shutdown)
    before = protected(root)
    receipt = base/'serve.preserves'
    result = call(root, 'serve', '--max-ticks', '1', '--max-requests-per-tick', '1',
                  '--receipt-out', receipt, expected=None)
    assert result.returncode in [0, 1], events[-1]
    value = receipt.read_text()
    assert '<decision "deny">' in value, value
    assert '<stopped "false">' in value, value
    assert protected(root) == before
    canonical['unresolved-service'] = value
    return 'unresolved-historical-completion-propagates-service-denial-without-shutdown'

try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='molten-f14-review-consumer-') as temporary:
        base = Path(temporary)
        if mode == 'pending':
            cases = [completed_with_pending(base/'pending')]
        elif mode == 'positive':
            cases = [repeat_stop(base/'repeat'), completed_with_pending(base/'pending')]
        else:
            assert mode == 'negative'
            cases = [unavailable_status(base/'status'), unresolved_service(base/'service')]
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'canonical': canonical}, sort_keys=True))
    sys.exit(1 if mode == 'negative' else 0)
except Exception:
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'events': events, 'canonical': canonical}, sort_keys=True), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('/home/brittonr/git/aspen-worktrees/guided-goal-completion-20261015')
evidence = repo / 'evidence/cairn-source-remediation-2026-10-15/attempt-17-current-run-acceptance-repair'
prior = repo / 'evidence/cairn-source-remediation-2026-10-15/attempt-16-current-run-shutdown-observation'
scratch = Path(__file__).parent
binary = Path(os.environ['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']) / 'debug/molten'


def save(name, value):
    path = evidence / name
    if path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f'Preserving existing artifact: {path}')
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


def run(name, argv, expected=0):
    destination = evidence / (name + '.json')
    if destination.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f'Preserving existing execution record: {destination}')
    recorded = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(scratch / 'record-command.py'), str(destination), *argv],
                              cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if not destination.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(recorded.stderr)
    record = json.loads(destination.read_text())
    if record['exit_code'] != expected or record['timed_out']:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: {record["exit_code"]} != {expected}: {record["stderr"]}')
    print(json.dumps({'record': destination.name, 'exit_code': record['exit_code']}), flush=True)
    return record


def digest(path):
    result = subprocess.run(['b3sum', str(path)], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return 'blake3:' + result.stdout.split()[0]


for name in ['ordered-octet-workspace', 'ordered-octet-library', 'ordered-object-corpus',
             'ordered-artifact-import', 'ordered-strict-ci-gate', 'ordered-remediation-plan',
             'ordered-workspace-all-targets', 'ordered-workspace-doctests', 'ordered-enabled-feature-tests',
             'ordered-disabled-profiler-tests', 'ordered-default-clippy', 'ordered-enabled-clippy']:
    gate = json.loads((evidence / (name + '.json')).read_text())
    if gate['exit_code'] != 0 or gate['timed_out']:
        raise RuntimeError(f'Incomplete required acceptance: {name}')

build = run('native-consumer-current-library-selection',
            ['cargo', 'build', '--offline', '--locked', '--lib', '--message-format=json'])
messages = [json.loads(line) for line in build['stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
artifacts = [message for message in messages if message.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
             and message.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'molten'
             and 'lib' in message['target']['kind']]
if len(artifacts) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Expected one current Molten library artifact, got {len(artifacts)}')
libraries = [Path(filename) for filename in artifacts[0]['filenames'] if filename.endswith('.rlib')]
if len(libraries) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Expected one actual rlib')
library = libraries[0]
linked_paths = sorted({path for message in messages if message.get('reason') == 'build-script-executed'
                       for path in message.get('linked_paths', [])})
consumer = scratch / 'traceability17'
compile_argv = ['rustc', '--edition', '2024', str(scratch / 'traceability.rs'), '--extern',
                'molten=' + str(library), '-L', 'dependency=' + str(library.parent / 'deps'), '-o', str(consumer)]
for path in linked_paths:
    compile_argv += ['-L', path]
run('native-traceability-consumer-compile', compile_argv)
save('native-consumer-library-provenance.json', {'selected_artifact': artifacts[0], 'library': str(library),
     'library_bytes': digest(library), 'binary': str(binary), 'binary_bytes': digest(binary),
     'native_link_paths': linked_paths, 'compiler_record': 'actual-rust-toolchain.json'})

runs = {}
for name, script, mode, expected in [
    ('final-cli-positive', 'cli-consumer.py', 'positive', 0),
    ('final-cli-expected-deny', 'cli-consumer.py', 'negative', 1),
    ('final-reviewed-cli-positive-canonical-pending', 'review-consumer.py', 'positive', 0),
    ('final-reviewed-cli-expected-deny', 'review-consumer.py', 'negative', 1),
]:
    record = run(name, ['python3', str(scratch / script), str(binary), mode], expected)
    observed = json.loads(record['stdout'])
    if name == 'final-cli-positive':
        for label, stopped in [('first_loop', 'yes'), ('duplicate_loop', 'no'), ('current_loop', 'yes')]:
            value = observed['canonical'][label]
            assert '<decision "pass">' in value, value
            assert f'<stopped "{stopped}">' in value, value
    streams = evidence / 'execution-streams'
    streams.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    stdout_path, stderr_path = streams / (name + '.stdout.txt'), streams / (name + '.stderr.txt')
    stdout_path.write_text(record['stdout'])
    stderr_path.write_text(record['stderr'])
    canonical_refs = []
    canonical_dir = evidence / 'canonical-observations'
    canonical_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for label, text in observed.get('canonical', {}).items():
        source = canonical_dir / (name + '--' + label + '.preserves')
        packed = source.with_suffix('.packed')
        source.write_text(text)
        run('pack-' + name + '--' + label, [str(consumer), 'pack', str(source), str(packed)])
        canonical_refs.append(digest(packed))
    runs[name + '.json'] = {'record': record, 'observed': observed,
        'stdout_ref': digest(stdout_path), 'stderr_ref': digest(stderr_path), 'canonical_refs': canonical_refs}

compiler = json.loads((evidence / 'actual-rust-toolchain.json').read_text())
if compiler['exit_code'] != 0:
    raise RuntimeError('Actual compiler observation failed')
(evidence / 'compiler-version.txt').write_text(compiler['stdout'])
save('execution-drivers.json', {'scope': 'Executed F14 CLI/native consumers; bounded local lifecycle facts only.',
     'sources': [{'name': name, 'source': (scratch / name).read_text()}
                 for name in ['cli-consumer.py', 'review-consumer.py', 'traceability.rs', Path(__file__).name]]})
source_ref = digest(evidence / 'source-content-hashes.txt')
drivers_ref = digest(evidence / 'execution-drivers.json')
toolchain_refs = [digest(evidence / 'compiler-version.txt'), digest(evidence / 'native-consumer-library-provenance.json')]
save('verification-profile.json', {'scope': 'Exactly four F14 requirements over current root Rust; not a release closure or live external-adapter campaign.',
     'root_source_files': 1897, 'source_content_hashes': source_ref, 'driver_sources': drivers_ref,
     'actual_compiler_version': compiler['stdout'], 'source_build_selection': 'native-consumer-current-library-selection.json',
     'ordered_acceptance': 'Source producers/strict-ci gate, default/feature tests and default/enabled Clippy were checked passing; lifecycle acceptance independently requires every remaining ordered gate.',
     'actual_cli_records': list(runs), 'positive_expected_exit': 0, 'negative_expected_exit': 1,
     'negative_driver_contract': 'Only all intended observed denials and unchanged-lifecycle assertions yield 1; unexpected consumer failures yield 2.'})
profile_ref = digest(evidence / 'verification-profile.json')
gate_record = json.loads((evidence / 'ordered-strict-ci-gate.json').read_text())
gate_refs = [word for word in gate_record['stdout'].split() if word.startswith('blake3:')]
if len(gate_refs) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Expected native source-gate receipt identity')
gate_ref = gate_refs[0]
coverage = []
receipt_paths = []
for entry in json.loads((prior / 'requirement-evidence-map.json').read_text())['receipts']:
    execution = runs[entry['actual_run_record']]
    name = entry['requirement'].rsplit('.', 1)[1] + '-' + entry['kind']
    receipt_path = evidence / 'verification-runs' / (name + '.preserves')
    receipt_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    record = execution['record']
    argv = [str(binary), 'test', 'traceability', 'verification-run', '--requirement', entry['requirement'],
        '--coverage-kind', entry['kind'], '--target', entry['target'], '--profile-ref', profile_ref,
        '--exit-status', str(record['exit_code']), '--stdout-ref', execution['stdout_ref'],
        '--stderr-ref', execution['stderr_ref'], '--out', str(receipt_path)]
    argv += ['--argv=' + argument for argument in record['argv']]
    for reference in toolchain_refs:
        argv += ['--toolchain-ref', reference]
    for reference in [source_ref, drivers_ref, digest(evidence / entry['actual_run_record']), gate_ref, *execution['canonical_refs']]:
        argv += ['--artifact-ref', reference]
    emitted = run(name + '-verification-emission', argv)
    coverage.append({'requirement': entry['requirement'], 'kind': entry['kind'], 'target': entry['target'],
        'actual_run_record': entry['actual_run_record'], 'actual_run_exit': record['exit_code'],
        'cases': execution['observed']['cases'], 'native_receipt': str(receipt_path.relative_to(repo)),
        'native_emission': emitted['stderr']})
    receipt_paths.append(str(receipt_path))
save('requirement-evidence-map.json', {'scope': 'Exactly four F14 requirements from fresh actual CLI executions.', 'receipts': coverage,
     'additional_expected_denial_run': 'final-cli-expected-deny.json', 'non_claim': 'No release, external adapter or whole-system proof.'})
run('native-f14-pre-sync-receipt-backed-traceability', [str(consumer), str(repo),
    str(repo / '.cairn/changes/bind-shutdown-observations-to-current-node-run/specs/node-runtime/spec.md'),
    str(evidence / 'f14-pre-sync-traceability.preserves'), *receipt_paths])
